source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 300 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 300.

PD 300.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 300 was established by Ordinance No. 20098, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 12, 1988. Ordinance No. 20098 amended Ordinance Nos. 10962 and 19455, Chapters 51 and 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19455; 20098; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 300 is established on property generally located at the west corner of Douglas Avenue and Hall Street. The size of PD 300 is approximately 22,550 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development of the Property must conform with the development plan (Exhibit 300A). The director may not authorize minor changes in the development plan which would otherwise be authorized under Section 51A-4.702(h). (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.105. USES.

Use of the Property is limited to multifamily uses and a transitional living center for persons with head trauma and spinal cord injuries. All clients of the transitional living center shall live at the facility and receive retraining in life skills from vocational rehabilitation consultants, occupational consultants, speech therapists, life skill tutors, fitness specialists, and other professionals specializing in life skill retraining. (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)

sections.title: Driving Of Private Vehicles Prohibited
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.106. DRIVING OF PRIVATE VEHICLES PROHIBITED.

In order to insure that the parking provided for this use is adequate, residents of the transitional living center are prohibited from driving private vehicles to and from the Property. (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Number Of Residents
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.107. MAXIMUM NUMBER OF RESIDENTS.

No more than 26 persons may reside in the transitional living center at one time. (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Number Of Dwelling Units
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.108. MAXIMUM NUMBER OF DWELLING UNITS.

Multifamily uses on the Property are permitted the maximum number of dwelling units permitted in an MF-2 Subdistrict of PD 193 (see Article 193). (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.109. SETBACKS.

Setbacks for the transitional living center must be provided as shown on the development plan. If the Property is redeveloped with multifamily uses and the development plan is amended accordingly, setbacks must be provided as required for an MF-2 Subdistrict of PD 193. (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.110. MAXIMUM HEIGHT.

No structure on the Property may exceed 36 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.111. MAXIMUM COVERAGE.

The site is limited to the maximum coverage permitted in an MF-2 Subdistrict of PD 193. (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)

sections.title: Common Facilities
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.112. COMMON FACILITIES.

The transitional living center may provide a common dining area, kitchen area, living room, and meeting rooms for the residents. (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.113. PARKING.

A minimum of 0.3 parking spaces for each bed must be provided on the Property for the transitional living center. A multifamily use must provide parking as required in PD 193. (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.114. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must conform with the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.115. SIGNS.

(a) All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Division 51A-7.400.

(b) The transitional living center is only permitted to display signs that identify the use of the Property as a residential use. (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)

sections.title: Loading Docks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.116. LOADING DOCKS.

Loading docks are prohibited on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)

sections.title: Garbage Pick-Up And Delivery Trucks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.117. GARBAGE PICK-UP AND DELIVERY TRUCKS.

Garbage pick-up and delivery trucks are prohibited on the Property between the hours of 7:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m. (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.118. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Use of the Property must comply with the requirements of all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.119. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.120. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-300.121. ZONING MAP.

PD 300 is located on Zoning Map No. I-7. (Ord. Nos. 20098; 25711)
